testcase.name: Authentication flow › should display the IMAS login form on first load
Authentication flow › should switch to the registration form when the signup link is clicked
Authentication flow › should switch back to the login form from registration mode
Authentication flow › should show an error message when login credentials are invalid
Authentication flow › should enforce minimum password length in register form
Authentication flow › should display the subtitle "Institut Mallorquí d'Afers Socials"
Navigation — unauthenticated state › should redirect unauthenticated users to the login page
Navigation — unauthenticated state › should not show the navigation bar when unauthenticated
Navigation — unauthenticated state › should not show the logout button when unauthenticated
Navigation — form accessibility constraints › email field should have type="email" for browser validation
Navigation — form accessibility constraints › password field should have type="password" (not plaintext)
Navigation — form accessibility constraints › password field in register mode should require minimum 8 characters
Navigation — form accessibility constraints › submit buttons should be of type="submit"
Navigation — page title and meta › should have a page title
